chapter_mission: Establish Corellian political context on the ground: Prime Minister Aidel Saxan's defiance of the Alliance; Dur Gejjen's shadow; Thrackan Sal-Solo as a figure waiting in the wings.
chapter_turn: The Corellian political architecture comes into focus — the independence movement has legitimate leadership and illegitimate challengers, and Thrackan is both.

scene_plan.purpose: Saxan delivers a Corellian policy address defying Alliance pressure; Dur Gejjen shadow in the room.
Han and Leia on the Falcon discussing the Corellian trajectory; the marriage strain previewed.

exit_vector: Saxan publicly defiant at a Corellian press conference; private political chess underway behind her.
notes: Builds the Corellian antagonist side in its own POV terms. Saxan established as sympathetic; Thrackan as recognizable Solo-cousin presence.
